analysis_unit: Pair prompt/intervention conditions within the exact snapshot and report the six state types separately. Event definitions can land on the same history prefix, so do not pool 120 slots as 120 independent states.
purpose: Prompt selection by validity, evidence grounding, rationale completion, and cost only; never select by true-best outcome.

state_type_definitions.after_first_positive_reward: first state immediately after observing reward 1
state_type_definitions.after_first_two_consecutive_zero_rewards: first state immediately after observing two adjacent zeros
state_type_definitions.first_partial_tried_untried: first state with 2..K-1 distinct tried arms
